Morgan Lee: quick shout 3: customer 'Greenfield Labs' on private deploy saw services throw 403 decrypts right after a maintenance window. Suspect key rotation + netpol tweak overlap.
Ibrahim Khan: timeline? what changed in the window?
Morgan Lee: maintenance started 2026-02-22T09:00 UTC. We rotated keys and tightened egress for keystore-proxy pods (deny-by-default -> explicit egress). First 403s at 09:02.
sec-bot: Alert: decrypt_403_spike tenant=greenfield at 2026-02-22T09:02:18Z. Audit ref=audit-rot-176892.
Oncall Ops: logs (sanitized):
```
2026-02-22T09:02:17Z keystore-proxy ERROR tenant=greenfield msg="decrypt denied" code=403 key=kms://greenfield/v20260222 principal=svc-gf-proxy
2026-02-22T09:02:17Z netpol-controller INFO applied policy gf-ks-egress allow:hsm-ip-range
2026-02-22T09:02:18Z hsm-connector WARN principal_check failed: principal missing from key policy
```
Priya Rao: interesting. Netpol applied but allowed HSM range. That suggests auth failure rather than network. Did rotation job propagate principals?
sec-bot: Rotation metadata: infra-rotator v2.0.8 executed. Flag --propagate-principals not set. Audit shows alias flip at 09:01:58Z, principal patch absent. Known issue tracked INF-512.
Ibrahim Khan: so alias pointed to v2 but principals still only on v1. Why did netpol change at same window? That increases blast radius.
Morgan Lee: yep. Mitigation: Oncall Ops ran `kmsctl grant --key v20260222 --principal svc-gf-proxy --actions decrypt` and verified decrypts returned 200 at 09:04. Customer services recovered.
Oncall Ops: confirmed. Uploaded remediation command and audit snapshot to incident artifacts.
Priya Rao: fallout: compliance will want exact timing and proof that we didn't widen permissions. We granted principal-scoped decrypt only. Need to include proof in postmortem.
Ibrahim Khan: security follow-ups: 1) change rotator default to propagate principals=true; 2) add invariant check: principals_present == true before alias swap; 3) require maint windows that change both network policy and key material to be serialized (no simultaneous netpol + key flips); 4) harden RBAC so grants require justification trace (why and who).
sec-bot: Note: added incident tags INF-512-hotfix, INF-513-netpol-serialization. Also attached audit entries: rotation-start, alias-swap, netpol-apply, manual-grant.
Morgan Lee: vuln triage note: if an attacker could trigger a rotation while pushing a netpol that temporarily allows egress to a rogue HSM endpoint, could they perform a malicious key swap? Risk low but file as security review item.
Priya Rao: good catch. Add a threat-model card to backlog: rotation+netpol orchestration atomicity. Also require HSM endpoints be validated by TLS cert pinning and KMS service identity checks.
Ibrahim Khan: incident actionables: HOTFIX deploy rotator v2.0.9 (propagate default), infra-agent preflight smoke test, keystore-proxy retry-policy for 403s during rotation (special-case transient), and an alert: >3 decrypt 403s in 2 minutes per tenant.
Oncall Ops: I'll push hotfix and upload migration notes for customers.
Morgan Lee: I'll draft customer notice with exact timestamps, remediation steps we took, and ETA for hotfix (48h) + full rollout (2 weeks).
Priya Rao: include audit artifacts and an offer to provide a signed attestation for compliance teams.
sec-bot: Reminder: update private-deploy preflight checklist to include principal propagation smoke, netpol serialization check, and HSM cert verification.
Ibrahim Khan: closing: please link the postmortem in #eng-security once ready. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
